title.why: The guideline's own FAQ cites 「고영향 인공지능 판단 가이드라인」; the English title renders it accurately (the cover's own English title is not in a text layer).

original_title.why: Character match with the FAQ citation and the NIA file name.

issuing_body.why: Art. 33(3) gives the Minister the duty to publish; the NIA post distributes it and the cover shows MSIT and NIA logos.

date_last_updated.why: NIA notice 2026-04-29 revision upload and file 260429.

status.why: NIA: current files published; the FAQ states it is not legally binding.

legal_force.why: FAQ on legal force: 법적 구속력이 있는 것은 아니며.

summary_claims.claim: Two-step test: area listed in Art. 2(4) and whether use may significantly affect or endanger life, physical safety or fundamental rights

Areas: energy, drinking water, health care, medical devices, nuclear safety, biometric analysis for criminal investigation or arrest, hiring and loan screening, transport, public-service decisions, student assessment (Art. 2(4)(가)-(차))
summary_claims.locator: KR-02 Art. 2(4); page 8 of the guideline quoting it

summary_claims.claim: Expert committee advice is non-binding and optional; the Minister's confirmation is an administrative view, with courts having the final say
summary_claims.locator: page 7, FAQ (전문위원회의 판단은 법적 구속력이 없는 자문 ... 법원의 사법적 판단)

summary_claims.claim: Annexes reproduce the Act and the draft Enforcement Decree (시행령안, page 185) and request forms

scope.note: Government guideline under an AI law.

note: Own literal translation: 'The Minister's confirmation is an administrative procedure and, like other administrative interpretations, remains an administrative judgment; the final civil and criminal determination is made by judicial judgment of the courts.' The Art. 2(4) list in the summary is a faithful short form; 'biometric identification' of the earlier text was correctly narrowed to analysis of biometric information for criminal investigation or arrest. english_version stays 'none found' although the cover has an English title; not recordable as a version of the text. No newer revision than 29 April 2026 found.
